title: "Jak hrát?" tile next to the date
summary: No first-visit interruption: a paper-coloured "JAK HRÁT?" tile joins the DNES / SOBOTA / date tiles and turns red on hover. Tapping it opens a popover with the three rules (one word, the blue "?" clues and their cost, five lives and scoring) and a "Celá pravidla" link to the rules section. Shot 0 is closed, shot 1 open.
tradeoffs: Always visible and never in the way, but a newcomer has to notice and tap it; on phones it wraps onto a second line under the date tiles.
